title: Seconds to minutes
description:
Split seconds into minutes and seconds with one division.

```
Seconds: 125
2 min 5 s
```

starter.main.asm:
global  _start

        section .data
ask:    db      "Seconds: ", 0
s_min:  db      " min ", 0
s_sec:  db      " s", 0

        section .text
_start:
        lea     rdi, [rel ask]
        call    print_str
        call    read_int
        ; TODO

        mov     eax, 60
        xor     edi, edi
        syscall

hints: `mov ecx, 60` then `div rcx`: the minutes are in `rax` and the seconds in `rdx` (lesson 2.02).
Move both into `rbx` and `r12` before printing, because `print_int` changes `rax` and `rdx`.
requirements: One `div` gives both the quotient (`rax`) and the remainder (`rdx`).
Use unsigned division with `xor edx, edx` first.
stretch: Add hours with a second division.
